_about: Test islands for sea step 4's streaming (the real hand-made islands come with the regions, step 13): sea coordinates, radius (m), model (assets/models/sea/<model>.glb), far = the plain silhouette shown beyond `near` metres; within `near` the full model stands, beyond `far` nothing (fog). Island kit (director: kit + a showcase start island, textured blend ground + plenty of props): an island with props = data/sea/isles/<props>.json draws them (game/sea_isle_props.gd) and gets the blended ground (game/isle_ground.gd) in its ground tints (sand, grass, rock, wet, path; missing = the defaults). props: range = metres a model is drawn to (default for the rest), thin = small clutter dropped on lower tiers, tiers = share of thinned clutter kept and range multiplier per graphics tier, shadows = models that cast shadows. The start island replaces test_small; the shipyard (data/sea/ships.json) sits in its east cove.
